Prague's offer comes after Russian weapons entered Polish airspace during a large-scale attack on western Ukraine on 20 November.
After a series of Russian violations of Polish airspace, authorities in Prague have said they are ready to help Warsaw. The offer of support was announced by Defence Minister Jaromír Zůna and Chief of the General Staff Miroslav Hlaváč.

Zůna stressed that any involvement of the Czech armed forces would depend on the needs identified by Poland within NATO.
He also underlined that strengthening the security of countries on NATO's eastern flank remains one of the Czech military's most important tasks.
"This is our priority," Zůna said at a press conference. He also referred to Czech AH-1Z Viper military helicopters, which are currently deployed in Poland.

Source : Defence24 , as reported by European Pravda

titulekPuvodni: Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
shrnuti: Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.

vyrez.text:
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
November 18, 2026, 9:26 am
Source: Rzeczpospolita
Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.
They said the sabotage could have been staged as a “false flag” operation meant to pin the blame on Kyiv.
The warning about the planned sabotage came from intelligence services in partner countries, though analysts at Polish intelligence agencies also raised the possibility of a provocation, the newspaper’s sources said. Rzeczpospolita reported that similar warnings were sent to intelligence services in the Baltic states: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.
“We had information about specific sites where the attack was supposed to take place. The Russians were counting on a large number of casualties,” one of the newspaper’s sources…

Bomb disposal experts are preparing to destroy a 250-kilogram World War II aerial bomb found in a Pärnu County field at an Estonian Defense Forces' training area, Postimees reported .

The Western Estonia Bomb Disposal Unit (Lääne-Eesti pommigrupp) is now preparing to render the device safe.
A metal detectorist had discovered the 250-kilogram aerial bomb about 30 centimeters underground in a field in Lemmetsa village just north of Pärnu City on Sunday.
Thanks to its considerable destructive power, the bomb could not be destroyed at the Rescue Board's usual demolition site in nearby Potsepa.

Skip to main content
Hundreds of schools in Germany and Denmark receive bomb threats
November 23, 2026, 10:31 pm
Source: Bloomberg
Schools in Germany and Denmark have received bomb threats. Authorities in both countries are investigating and believe the threats were hoaxes.
In Denmark, the threats were emailed to several schools across the country. Police said they saw no need at this point to evacuate schools or take special security measures.
In Germany, about 450 schools nationwide received threats, including schools in Berlin, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, and Thuringia.
Since mid-October, schools in several European countries, as well as airlines, airports, and media outlets, have received false bomb threats. It remains unclear who sent the messages. The Financial Times reported that European intelligence agencies are looking into whether Russia was involved in sending the threats.

Preliminary reports indicate two people were rescued, and five others injured, including a foreign national, Klitschko said . Russia has intensified its attacks on Kyiv over the past several weeks. On Nov. 17, Russian ballistic missiles struck two key bridges across the Dnipro River. Russia’s Foreign Ministry said Monday that it summoned Estonia’s top diplomat in Moscow to protest the Baltic country’s decision to close all border crossings with Russia starting next month.
Estonia announced last week that it would close its three road border crossings with Russia for at least six months beginning on Dec. 1 after Estonian security services said they foiled a Moscow-linked plot against a local drone manufacturer.
Russia, in response, has accused Estonia of erecting a “new Iron Curtain” and promised retaliatory measures.
The Foreign Ministry told Estonia’s chargé d’affaires Marek Ühtegi that the “unfounded” accusations exposed Tallinn’s “fierce Russophobia.” The ministry warned that the planned border closure would backfire against Estonia and Europe more broadly.

shrnuti: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte warned a separate EU military alongside national militaries could slow responses, saying Putin could reach Rotterdam first.

Rutte sceptical of EU military: Putin would reach Rotterdam | Ukrainska Pravda
NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has said that creating a single European armed force could be harmful in the event of a Russian attack, as coordinating joint steps with the Alliance and national militaries would take too much time.
Source: Rutte speaking at the 72nd annual session of the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin, as reported by European Pravda
Details: Rutte explained that he is not opposed to creating a European military, but if the initiative were implemented, he believes it would make sense to abolish EU countries' national militaries so that they do not duplicate each other's responsibilities.

" My point has always been that if you have a European military, you cannot also have national militaries. The United States has one military. There is not a specific army or navy for the state of New York or for the state of California. It is one integrated United States military. Angaben der Polizei
Bombendrohungen an Hunderten Schulen bundesweit
Stand: 23.11.2026 • 12:55 Uhr
Freiburg, Erfurt oder Hamburg: Hunderte Schulen im ganzen Land haben Drohschreiben bekommen. Mehrere Schulen wurden vorsorglich geräumt. Laut verschiedenen Polizeibehörden gibt es aber keine Hinweise auf eine konkrete Gefahr.
An zahlreichen Schulen bundesweit gibt es aktuell Bombendrohungen. Entsprechende E-Mails seien am Morgen unter anderem in Jena, Erfurt, Nordhausen, Gotha, Rudolstadt und Greiz in Thüringen eingegangen, teilte etwa die Landespolizeidirektion in Erfurt mit. Auch andere Bundesländer seien betroffen, hieß es. Einzelne Schulen, etwa in Freiburg, wurden vorsorglich geräumt.
Die Polizei in Thüringen geht nach eigenen Angaben nicht davon aus, dass die Drohungen ernst gemeint sind. Den Schulen werde empfohlen, die Einrichtungen nicht zu räumen und den Schulbetrieb normal fortzusetzen. Zu den Verfassern der Schreiben lägen keine Erkenntnisse vor.

November 23, 2026, 9:23 am
Source: Government of Poland
Debris from X-101 cruise missiles turned up in all three Polish towns where Russian objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine on November 20.
Polish military equipment and weapons experts who examined the fragments that fell in the towns of Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Mołodycz reached that conclusion.
According to preliminary findings, all the missiles were manufactured in the fourth quarter of 2026 at a plant in the city of Dubna, Moscow region, Polish prosecutors said.
NATO will hold an emergency meeting at its headquarters in Brussels on November 23 over the Russian missiles that violated Polish airspace. Poland’s Deputy Defense Minister Paweł Zalewski told Polish Radio that the meeting would discuss ways to strengthen air defense for Poland and NATO’s eastern flank.

Ruský prezident Vladimir Putin nie je priateľom Spojených štátov, pokiaľ ide o Ukrajinu, uviedol v nedeľu riaditeľ amerických spravodajských služieb Jay Clayton. Vyjadril sa niekoľko dní po tom, ako prezident USA Donald Trump označil ruského lídra za svojho priateľa. Informovala o tom agentúra Reuters, píše TASR.

Dva ruské diplomaty vyhostil Kypr kvůli podezření ze špionáže. Zpravodajské služby tam odhalily síť, která se snažila získat tajné informace o bezpečnosti ostrova i EU a dostat se k sankcionovaným technologiím, píše Politico.
Článek
Z Kypru byli vyhoštěni dva ruští diplomaté kvůli podezření ze špionáže, uvedl server Politico s odvoláním na dva nejmenované kyperské představitele. O vyhoštění Rusů podle portálu nejprve informovala místní televizní stanice ANT1 Live.
Podle dvou vysoce postavených vládních představitelů, kteří si přáli zůstat v anonymitě, aby mohli o záležitosti otevřeně hovořit, odhalily tamní zpravodajské služby špionážní síť, jež se snažila získat tajné informace o bezpečnosti Kypru a Evropské unie. Tato síť se rovněž pokoušela dostat k informacím o technologiích, jejichž převod do Ruska je zakázán v rámci sankcí EU.
Oba diplomaté podle zmíněných činitelů…
